VPRS — mid-series TCC change via per-race rating override

A VPRS boat can be re-measured part-way through a series (a new certificate). The competitor keeps its *current* TCC; earlier races are pinned to the old value with a per-race rating override on the vprsTcc field — exactly the IRC mechanism. Here Zelus races on TCC 1.000 in race 1 (override) and on its current TCC 0.900 in race 2. Race 1, start 14:00:00 — both sail 1:00:00 elapsed (3600 s): Optique TCC 1.000 CT 3600.0 → tie 1st Zelus TCC 1.000 (override) CT 3600.0 → tie 1st Identical corrected times share rank 1 (RRS A8 averaged: 1.5 each). Race 2, start 14:00:00: Optique finish 15:00:00 ET 3600 TCC 1.000 CT 3600.0 → 2nd Zelus finish 15:05:00 ET 3900 TCC 0.900 (current) CT 3510.0 → 1st Without the race-1 override Zelus would score on 0.900 there too (CT 3900 × 0.9 = 3510 ≠ 3600) — the override is what reproduces race 1.

Scoring system: VPRS 
Points:
  Optique: race1 1.5 (tie), race2 2  → total 3.5
  Zelus:   race1 1.5 (tie), race2 1  → total 2.5  (rank 1)
